lane: صَيْدَنٌ _A firm, strong,_ or _compact, building._ (M.) === And _A firm, strong,_ or _compact, garment,_ or _piece of cloth:_ (M:) or _a_ [_garment of the kind called_] كِسَآء _that is stout,_ or _strong,_ or _that is thick,_ or _compact, in texture._ (K.) === And _A king;_ (S, M, K;) because of the firmness of his rule, or his state, or condition; as also ↓صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ and صَيْدَلَانِىٌّ. (M.) === And _A fox;_ (S, M, K;) as also ↓صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ: (K:) or الصَّيْدَنُ is one of the names thereof. (TA.) === And The _hyena._ (K.) === See also صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ. === Also _A species of fly, that makes a buzzing sound over the herbage._ (IKh, TA.) === And, as also صَيْدَلٌ, _Stones_ [i. e. _pieces of ore_] _of silver:_ to which are likened what are termed حِجَارَةٌ العَقَاقِيرِ. (IDrst, TA. [See صَيْدَلٌ; and see also صَيْدَانٌ, below.])

entries.text: الصيدن: الضبع، والكساء الصفيق، والملك، والثعلب، ودويبة تعمل لنفسها بيتا في الأرض، وتعميه، كالصيدناني فيهما. والصيدناني: الصيدلاني.
